description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class which implements the LogNode interface. It acts as a filter in a logging chain, passing only message content without metadata or additional information. It can be used to simplify logs for on-screen display by filtering out tags, priorities, or exceptions.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter for log messages that only passes the message content, excluding metadata like priority, tag, or exceptions. Implements the LogNode interface to be part of a logging chain.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter(LogNode next)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter()
methods.description: Default constructor that creates an instance without a subsequent LogNode.

methods.name: println(int priority, String tag, String msg, Throwable tr)
methods.description: Replaces the message with null tag and no throwable, forwarding only the message content at NONE priority to the next LogNode.

methods.name: getNext()
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext(LogNode node)
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
